text: הֶחָרֵט בַּסֵּפֶר. לְבִלְתִּי מְצוֹא כֹפֶר. קִיּוּם זִכְרוֹן זֶה סֵפֶר. לְפָנָיו יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר צְפוּן מוֹרְדֵי אוֹר. תָּמִים דּוֹר כָּאוֹר. צִיָּה כְּחַת לָאוּר. קִנְיָן יִזְכֹּר: צְפוּפִים פְּנֵי נָאוֹר. מִשְׁפָּטָם תֵּת לָאוֹר. צַחַן רֹעַ שְׂאוֹר. בְּרִיב בַּל יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר פְּעֻלַּת אוֹרַח. הֶעִירוֹתָה מִמִּזְרָח. פָּעֳלוֹ יִזְרָח. בְּקֶרֶב שָׁנִים יִזְכֹּר: פַּח אִם הַמְרָח. פְּרַחֲיוֹ לְמָרַח. פִּלּוּלוֹ יִצְרַח. בְּעַדָם יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר עֲקֵדַת מוֹרִיָּה. כֵּהִית רְאִיָּה. עֲדֵי עֵרוֹם וְעֶרְיָה. סְבוּכוֹ יִזְכֹּר: עֲצַב מְרִירָה. אִם פוֹאֲבָה פוֹרִיָּה. עֲתָרוֹ לִרְאָיָה. וְלִזְכוּת יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר סֻלָּם חָלַם. וְעָלָיו מְחוֹלָלָם. שָׂרֵי אַרְבַּע וְעֻלָּם. בּוֹ כְּמֵאָז יִזְכֹּר: שְׁרוֹיוֹן בְּמַעֲלָם. וַיֹּאמֶר לְגָעֳלָם. שַׂחֲוּ

text: חֵמָה. וְיֻחַק לְדוֹרוֹת. שְׁמוֹ לְזִכָּרוֹן: וּמִי שׂוֹנֵא בָצַע. יְדַבֵּר עֲנוּ בִי. וַיַּעַן וַיֹּאמֶר עַד. אָדוֹן לְזִכָּרוֹן: וּבִטְלֵה חָלָב. יְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדֵנוּ. וּכְנֶגֶד שְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים. יַעַל לְזִכָּרוֹן: זָעַף יְרֵא וַיֹּאמַר. תְּהִי יָדְךָ בִי. אֲשֶׁר כִּלֵּב אֱלֹהָיו. הוּא לְזִכָּרוֹן: זָעַק וַתָּשָׁב. חֶרֶב אֶל נְדָנָה. וְהֻשַּׁת לוֹ כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ. כֵּס לְזִכָּרוֹן: חִכִּיתִי בְּעֵת עֲצִיר לְכוֹרֵחַ וּמַמְטִיר. כְּמֵשִׁיב רוּחַ לְיֶלֶד. אָבַד מִזִּכָּרוֹן: חַי לְהֵרָאוֹת בְּרִית. בְּדַבְּרוֹ קִנֵּאתִי. כִּי עָזְבוּ עַם בְּרִית וְזִכָּרוֹן: טֶרֶם הָיָה לִי. מְכַפֵּר פָּנִים מִנְחָה הוֹלֶכֶת. כְּשֹׁחַד לְזִכָּרוֹן: טוֹרַף נֵרְדְּ וּסְמָמִים. לְבַסֵּם חֲדָרָיו. דָּם וָחֵלֶב לְנִיחוֹחַ. וְלֶחֶם הַפָּנִים לְזִכָּרוֹן: יָצַקְתִּי עַל נַחֲלֵי רֵיקָה. כִּי לֹא אַלְמָן. שַׂחְתִּי יָהּ אַבְטַח בָּךְ. וְלֹא

atonement can be found, then He remembers the confirmation of this book. He remembers the hidden one (Noah) in the age of open rebels, the perfect and the pure; when He is angry and wishes to curse the earth, He remembers those acquired by Him (Israel). As to those who stand crowded together before the countenance of the Awe-inspiring, may He bring to light their judgment; may He not in strife recall the ugly evil leaven. He remembers the work of that strong one whom He told to rise up from the east (Abraham). May He soon recall his shining act. When destruction threatens to annihilate his offspring, may his supplication become audible that He may remember them kindly. He remembers the sacrifice on Moriah (Isaac) whose eyes become dim; for the sake of people naked and bare, may He recall the ram caught in the thicket. When the fruitful people is afflicted with a festering wound, may his prayer be manifest that God may remember his merit. He remembers him who saw the ladder in the dream (Jacob); above it the Creator appeared to him, showed him the princes of the four empires and their yoke. He will remember him, as in former days. back anger (like Pinhas), then let his name be inscribed for future generations as a remembrance. Who is it that hates gain that he might say: “Testify against me”, and the Lord Himself replied as a witness for remembrance. With a sucking lamb he (Samuel) atoned for us and, equal to the noble pair of brothers (Moses and Aaron), he rises for remembrance. When he saw the wrath of the Lord, he (David) said: “Let Thy hand turn against me”, that he conformed to the will of his God is his remembrance. He cried out and caused the angel’s sword to return to its sheath, therefore was his throne established as firmly as the sun for remembrance. At the time of drought I wait for Him who releases and brings rain (Elijah), who restored breath to the child already lost to remembrance. He lives on as a witness at circumcisions because he spoke of his zeal when the people had abandoned both covenant and remembrance. Formerly I had one who could atone before the Lord, when he brought the meal-offering as a bribe for remembrance. Gifts of nard and spices perfumed His chambers, blood and fat as a delight and the show-bread for remembrance. text: וְיִגְעֲלָם. בְּרִית לִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר נְקוּבֵי מַטּוֹת. שְׁבוּעוֹת מַטּוֹת. נְדִידוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת. לְאַמְּצָם יִזְכֹּר: נוֹשְׂאֵי עֹל מוֹטוֹת. אִם פֶּץ לַחֲמוֹטוֹת. נִיַּץ חֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת. לְכַפֵּר יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר מְצוּקִים. יְסוֹד מוּצָקִים. מְפַעֲלִים לְיֹצְקִים. בְּכוֹם חוּשׁ לִזְכֹּר: מִפִּי יוֹנְקִים. אֲשֶׁר בְּסוּף נוֹאֲקִים. מַאֲמַר בְּרִית וְהַחֻקִּים. דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר לֵין כְּפָרִים. וְאִמְרֵי שְׁפָרִים. לִמְשַׁלְּמֵי פָרִים. לִפְלֵאָה יִזְכֹּר: לְעֵת בִּקּוּר כְּפוּרִים. סְתוּרִים מְסַפְּרִים. לִשְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים. לְצֶדֶק יִזְכֹּר: זְכֹר כְּבוֹד מִשְׁכָּן. מְקוֹם דּוֹד שָׁכַן. כְּרוּבִים בּוֹ שִׁכֵּן. חֶסֶד נְעוּרִים יִזְכֹּר: כִּיּוֹר עִם כֵּן. וְנֹעַם קוֹל דוּכָן. כַּבִּיר בְּיוֹם מוּכָן. לַנְּבוֹנִים יִזְכֹּר:

בִנְדִיבִים. כִּי הֵם בַּקֶּבֶר. וְלָנֶצַח שִׁמְךָ לְזִכָּרוֹן: כָּל אֵלֶּה סְמָכוּנִי. וְרַחֲמֶיךָ בִּקַּשְׁתִּי. לוּלֵא הֵם תַּמְתִּי. וְאֵינֶנִּי לְזִכָּרוֹן: כִּי הֵם בְּרוֹעַ. עֶדְיְךָ לֹא בָאוּ. וּמְמוֹתְתְךָ בְּפִיהֶם. שָׂמוּ לְזִכָּרוֹן: לְיוֹם זֶה נִכְמַס. סְכַם הַשְּׁוּמוֹת. תְּחִלָּה לַיָּמִים. וְרֹאשׁ לְזִכָּרוֹן: לְהִקָּרֵא בוֹ. כָּתָב עֵט וְשָׁמִיר. גָּלוּי וּבָאוּר. וְיָדוּעַ לְזִכָּרוֹן: מָוֶת וְחַיִּים שָׁלוֹם וּמִלְחָמוֹת. צַחְצָחוֹת וְשֹׂבַע. בָּאִים לְזִכָּרוֹן: מַעַלְלֵי גֶבֶר. וּמִסְפַּר צְעָדָיו. נִשְׁכְּחוּ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ. וּלְאֵל לְזִכָּרוֹן: נִסְתְּרָה דַרְכִּי. מִי יָכוֹל שִׂיחַ. לַשָּׁוְא נִכְתַּב לִי. הֵחֵטְא לְזִכָּרוֹן: נֶגֶד פְּנֵי גֶבֶר. מַעֲשָׂיו יוֹכִיחוּ. וְיַעֲנֶה בוֹ כַחֲשׁוֹ עַד לְזִכָּרוֹן: שִׂיחוּ מְזִמּוֹת אֵל. יַחַד כָּל בְּנֵי אִישׁ. עִבְרוּ תַחַת שֵׁבֶט. כְּצֹאן לְזִכָּרוֹן: מִי סוֹגֵר

text: adherents are faithless and the Lord intends to reject them, may his prayer avail them that on their behalf the covenant may be remembered. He remembers the noble tribes (twelve), the oath of the tribes, the wanderings of the tribes does He recall, to strengthen them. When He says that He will crush those who bear the heavy yoke, then He remembers as an atonement the destruction of the site of the Sanctuary. He remembers the foundation stones (forefathers), who groan in Egyptian slavery. The sucklings who praised the Lord at the Sea of Reeds, the promise of the covenant (the circumcision) and the statutes (of the Torah), His holy word, all these does He remember. The memory of those who live austerely (students of the Torah) and study His beautiful sayings, who with their lips provide a substitute for sacrificial bullocks, He does remember. When the books that announce what is hidden, are examined, He remembers in love the wonderful pair of brothers. He remembers the honour of the sanctuary, the place where He, the Beloved, did dwell, where He allowed the Cherubim to rest, the love of our youth He remembers. The basin on its frame, the delightful voice (of the Levites) on the Temple steps, the Almighty recalls them in favour of the discerning on the appointed day of judgment.

for remembrance. O Lord, in Thee do I trust and not in princes, for they are in the grave and Thy Name is for ever for remembrance. All these supported me but I seek Thy compassion, without it I should have perished and not survived for remembrance. For in spite of their strength, they could not plead for me before Thee, those in whose mouths is Thy greatness have placed it there for remembrance. For this day has been stored the sum of assessments, it is the beginning of days and the first for remembrance. On it there is read out what was engraved with a diamond quill, what was revealed and explained and known in remembrance. Death and life, peace and war, dearth and abundance, appear for remembrance. The acts of man, the number of his steps, though forgotten by men, they are to God for remembrance. “My way is hidden” — who could say that? In vain was a sin inscribed for me for remembrance. In front of man his deeds give evidence, his falsehood bears witness against him for remembrance. Proclaim the plans of the Lord, all men together, pass under the staff like a flock for remembrance.
